test.name: A page read to confirm one fact reports the fact and links the page (direct-agent arm)
test.description: The delegation names a page by ARK and asks whether it confirms one fact. The agent reads it, reports what the page shows with its viewerUrl as a link, and invents no target entry.

input.delegation: Read the page at ark:/61903/3:1:33SQ-GRZ6-P95 and confirm whether Patrick Flynn was the executor of Thomas Flynn's estate. Log the read.

judge_context: This is the direct-agent arm: no routing skill is staged, and the delegation above is relayed verbatim into the agent. Grade the agent's own behaviour. The read is ad hoc (no plan item).
The right first move is image_transcribe on the ARK given. There is no film to browse and no target entry to find, so an image_search or volume_search is wasted work.
The page names Patrick Flynn as son and executor, so the answer is yes. The report gives that, with the page's viewerUrl as a link.
Should append a research_log_append entry for the read, outcome positive.
The agent's return should end with the summary_for_user block: a `---` line followed by two unlabeled paragraphs in plain language, with no identifiers, file names, tool names or field names in them.
